model_roles.embedder: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (local, in the vendor image, snapshot 5c38ec7c405ec4b44b94cc5a9bb96e735b38267a)
model_roles.reranker: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 (local, in the vendor image, snapshot 233902d25c440f23af6f7d6e94d2946bac0bee0a)

recipe-1.1.decision_model: none (HINDSIGHT_API_DECISION_MODEL_PROVIDER default, new since 0.10.2): no decision model, so recall and consolidation keep their LLM-only paths
recipe-1.1.settings: hindsight.recipe-1.1.env writes out every 1.1.0 server default that changed or is new since 0.10.2 and touches retain or recall: HINDSIGHT_API_ENTITY_TRGM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.3 (0.15 at 0.10.2), HINDSIGHT_API_DECISION_MODEL_PROVIDER=none, HINDSIGHT_API_CONSOLIDATION_USE_DECISION_MODEL=true (inert with no decision model), HINDSIGHT_API_RECALL_PREFER_OBSERVATIONS=false (the 1.1.0 client sends prefer_observations as null, which resolves to this server default; 0.10.2's client sent false); plus the 0.10.2 recipe's model values, unchanged
recipe-1.1.notes: Documented self-hosted install (server image + pgvector), every value the server default at v1.1.0: config.py DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER='openai', PROVIDER_DEFAULT_MODELS['openai']='gpt-4o-mini', DEFAULT_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER='local' with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=384), DEFAULT_RERANKER_PROVIDER='local' with cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, DEFAULT_DECISION_MODEL_PROVIDER='none', DEFAULT_ENTITY_TRGM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=0.3, DEFAULT_RECALL_PREFER_OBSERVATIONS=False. Unchanged from 0.10.2: DEFAULT_ENABLE_OBSERVATIONS=True (the shim turns observations off per bank), DEFAULT_RETAIN_EXTRACTION_MODE='concise', DEFAULT_RETAIN_CHUNK_SIZE=3000, DEFAULT_ENTITY_MERGE_MIN_SIMILARITY=0.3. DEFAULT_RERANKER_MAX_TOKENS_PER_CANDIDATE (renamed from the LiteLLM-only DEFAULT_RERANKER_LITELLM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_DOC and now applied to every reranker) stays unset, so no candidate is truncated, as at 0.10.2. One LLM serves every role; only retain runs here. Embedding and reranking make no provider calls.

time_notes: retain item `timestamp` = session event_time (AMB passes Document.timestamp the same way); recall `query_timestamp` = query_time, the anchor for relative dates and recency. An event_time or query_time without a UTC offset is read as UTC.
granularity: one retain item per session (content = JSON of the session's turns, as AMB serializes LoCoMo and LongMemEval sessions), document_id = source_id

provenance.mechanism: every recall result carries `document_id`, which is the source_id the shim passed to retain; a chunk item takes the document_id of the fact that cites it. Observations (consolidated facts) would carry no document_id and report unavailable, but they are disabled per bank (see deviations).

delete_notes: DocumentsApi.delete_document(bank, document_id): deletes the document and every memory unit and link extracted from it, and invalidates observations built on them. Re-retaining the same document_id replaces it (update_mode default 'replace').
readiness: retain is submitted with retain_async=true (as AMB does); /ingest polls OperationsApi.get_operation_status until completed or failed and then reads DocumentsApi.get_document().memory_unit_count; /finish polls OperationsApi.list_operations totals until in_flight = total - completed - failed is 0 (AMB `_in_flight_ops`), failed > 0 => degraded

vendor-default.notes: hindsight-client 1.1.0 `arecall` defaults (hindsight_client.py:1321-1339), the same values as 0.10.2: token-budgeted, not top-k. budget mid, max_tokens 4096 of fact text, chunks off, entities off, all fact types. prefer_observations is sent as null (the client default became None) and resolves to the server default, false. query_timestamp is always the question date.

fixed-evidence.notes: Same call with the fact-token cap raised to the shootout's 8,000-token evidence budget, so the harness packer, not Hindsight's 4,096 cap, decides what fits. Hindsight counts tokens with its own tokenizer, the harness with approxTokens; the packer truncates.

vendor_benchmark_reference.notes: What AMB's hindsight provider sends for LoCoMo (`_recall_kwargs`); BEAM uses max_tokens 12288 and max_chunk_tokens 8192. Recorded for reference, not a shootout policy.

retrieval_policies.item_mapping: recall results in Hindsight's rank order: world and experience facts -> type fact, observations -> type observation, text = AMB `_format_result` ('**[type]** text' plus an occurred/mentioned line); with include_chunks, each chunk follows the first fact that cites it as a type chunk item (AMB inlines it there). valid_from/valid_to stay null: occurred_start/occurred_end are when an event happened, not a validity window, so they live in the text.

client_compatibility: The adapter is the 0.10.2 bundle's shim.py, unchanged. Checked on the PyPI wheels of hindsight-client 0.10.2 and 1.1.0: the high-level methods it calls (Hindsight.__init__, acreate_bank, aretain_batch, arecall, aget_version) keep their signatures except arecall's prefer_observations default (False -> None); the generated calls it makes (BanksApi.delete_bank, DocumentsApi.get_document and delete_document, OperationsApi.get_operation_status and list_operations, MonitoringApi.get_readiness, MemoryApi.recall_memories and retain_memories) and the response fields it reads (RetainResponse, OperationStatusResponse, DocumentResponse, RecallResponse, RecallResult, ChunkData, DeleteDocumentResponse, OperationsListResponse, VersionResponse) are identical. recipe-1.1/shim.py adds one check: /health refuses unless the server's VersionResponse.api_version equals versions.server_version.
deviations_from_vendor_code: No raw dataset ids anywhere: AMB sets document_id and metadata.doc_id to '<sample_id>_<session>' and context to '... (session_N of conv-26)' or 'Session <question_id>_<session_id> ...'; the shim sends document_id = opaque source_id, no metadata at all (metadata influences extraction), and context = 'Conversation between <speakers>'.
No per-user tags: AMB tags items 'user:<id>' when it shares one bank; the shim uses one bank per namespace, which AMB also does in per-unit mode.
Turns are serialized as the harness sends them ({role, speaker, content}) instead of the dataset's own JSON keys (LoCoMo {speaker, dia_id, text}, LongMemEval {role, content}).
One retain request per session, waited on before the next session, instead of AMB's async batches of 20 items; ordering and per-session receipts follow the shootout's ingestion contract.
No retries: AMB retries failed submissions and failed operations up to 5 times; the shim reports a failed operation as a degraded session and the harness accounts for it.
Retrieval amount follows the shootout's two policies (client defaults, and an 8,000-token cap) rather than AMB's per-dataset recall settings, which are recorded under vendor_benchmark_reference.
Observations off: enable_observations=false per bank, as AMB's `_bank_kwargs` sets for every dataset, Hindsight's own benchmark setting. The server default (DEFAULT_ENABLE_OBSERVATIONS) is on.
HINDSIGHT_API_SKIP_LLM_VERIFICATION=true, so the server does not spend a provider call checking the key at boot (operational only).
